name: blast-drill-plan-visual
description: Visual verification of drill plan UI: grid creation, hole markers, spacing parameters, and plan inspection across multiple camera angles. #553: confirming a grid queues one drill_hole PendingAction per hole instead of writing holes instantly — holes sit ordered (ghosts) in plannedDrillHoles until a staffed driller/drill_rig actually drills each one, landing it in drillHoles.

steps.description: Staffed opening (#551): a driller with blasting + drill_rig licence, plus an unmanned drill_rig, are hired/purchased for free at game-open — exactly what #553's automatic drill dispatch needs.

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:2 cols:3 spacing:5 depth:6 start:20,20
steps.description: The grid tool's spacing stepper defaults to 3m (DEFAULT_SPACING_M, Drill.ts); two increment clicks on the strip's spacing stepper (data-field="spacing") raise it to 5 before dragging, so the (20,20)-(30,25) rectangle (10x5) computes the declared 3 cols x 2 rows. depth corrected from 8 to 6 (Ground rule #15/Finding #42's class, the whole-suite audit before Phase 3): this step never clicks the grid tool's depth stepper (data-field="depth"), so the real drag always produces the panel's own 6m default regardless of what's declared. #553: confirming the grid queues 6 drill_hole PendingActions and pushes 6 PlannedHoles into plannedDrillHoles — none are drilled yet, so holeCount stays 0 right after confirm. Hole count kept modest (6, not the larger pre-#553 pattern) so the staffed roster's ongoing maintenance/fuel costs (no income in this scenario) don't run the site into BANKRUPTCY_GRACE_TICKS territory before the plan finishes draining below.

expect.note: 2 rows x 3 cols = 6 holes ordered (ghosts) — none drilled yet (#553).

steps.description: #553: partial drilling — the staffed driller/drill_rig has had time to land some, but not all, of the 6 ordered holes. Mid-drilling screenshot for the visual channel to inspect the ghost/drilled split. Tick count is a first estimate from the spec's duration formula and staffed spawn offsets — tune once real timing is observed running against the implementation.

expect.note: Some holes have landed in drillHoles (real) while others remain in plannedDrillHoles (ghosts) — proves the split actually works.

steps.description: #553: drain the rest of the plan — every ordered hole eventually lands. Kept well under the staffed site's own bankruptcy-grace window (observed ~259 ticks with no income) since this is a single unconditional tick command, not a loop that stops once the plan finishes.

expect.note: All 6 holes have landed — none lost, none left ordered forever. Not yet charged/sequenced (that's the Charge/Sequence steps, out of scope for this scenario).
